scope: Read-only source review of new APP019 sealer plus available test/release/packaging/native components and in-memory rejection controls. Full GUI preflight and record/seal are not performed by this review.

checks.name: fixed source and test closure
checks.detail: Actual tests_and_release() accepted287 tests/44 suites, unchanged captured debug binaries, pinned capture script/log commands and all271 source inventory entries. Duplicate inventory paths and pre/post/current divergence are rejected.

checks.name: final release and packaging
checks.detail: Actual bundle_matches_release() matched all151 current/snapshot bundle entries, exact version0.19.0/build19 and executable1ebf6ad071aae23a79948350840963f17a96a7d6e8a9e5cba753f3ee408b60e2. Inherited read-only codesign/rpath/public-source/library/notice checks passed.

checks.name: native and historical closure
checks.detail: Actual native_integrity() accepted project-audio-setup finding/220-file manifest, APP018646-file manifest and recursively linked original histories/external records. It checked10438 unique file identities; known prior test supersession remains explicitly mapped to preserved exact bytes rather than relabeled unchanged.

checks.name: review input closure
checks.detail: Actual source review pins pass through recognized source_and_evidence and recursive record checks. The new sealer now accepts the frozen passed-with-scope status and rejects all three nonempty findings fields. Own sealer-review input will be checked during final preflight after this exclusive record exists.

checks.name: GUI and package checks by source read
checks.detail: Requires final-release observations and independent passed review with matching executable/test log, matching named group sets, nonempty evidence/observations/files, digest-checked group evidence and complete unchanged file sets for two distinct packages. Final required GUI records are still parent-owned and were not supplied to this review as completed evidence.

checks.name: path-only native review correction
checks.detail: Sealed native finding retains its anticipated external_path project-audio-setup-independent-review.json. New acceptance explicitly records that field/path together with the actual pinned saved-project-clock-independent-review.json and states path-only correction. The sealed native finding/manifest remain unchanged.

checks.name: publication and seal
checks.detail: record() runs preflight before exclusive outputs; captures complete source and packaging identities. seal() requires unchanged acceptance script/inputs and re-runs preflight, verifies current source versus snapshot, requires all four publication-pinned status files, then snapshots/seals with exclusive writes. verify() validates archived local inventory and pinned native histories without requiring later mutable application source to equal this old release.

corrections_during_review.detail: Initial exact-passed check rejected the already-frozen source review status. Author changed new sealer to accept exact passed or a space-delimited passed prefix; frozen source review unchanged.
Author added actual actionable_findings field alongside findings/open_actionable_defects. In-memory nonempty controls now reject all three.

full_preflight.reason: Final GUI observations, independent GUI review and package-baseline pair are not yet all finalized; no acceptance/seal outputs were attempted.

limits: The source and component checks are custody/instrument evidence, not scientific completeness, Cubase runtime or DAC verification.
No application build/test/GUI/vendor execution; codesign and otool inspections were read-only.
This report does not independently establish the final GUI claims; that review is separate.
